parameters.content:
## tg-ai-multipost_vk v2

Reads recent posts from public Telegram channels via an external Render-hosted parser,
deduplicates via per-channel Google Sheets, filters by importance (AI score 1–10, softer
threshold for video), skips repeated topics, rewrites text with OpenRouter,
publishes to Telegram / Facebook Page / Instagram / VK, sends a run report to a private Telegram group.

**v2 settings (wf_settings, optional):** importance_filter, importance_min (6),
importance_min_video (4), min_text_length (80), min_text_length_media (20),
topic_dedupe (true), topic_dedupe_hours (48).

**Required Credentials**
- `telegramApi`, `googleDriveOAuth2Api` + `googleSheetsOAuth2Api`, `openRouterApi`, `facebookGraphApi`

**Required Data Tables**: `wf_settings`, `wf_channels`, `wf_meta_tokens`, `wf_prompts`, `wf_runs`

See NODES.md in the repo.

### Init phase

Loads global settings and prompts as `{ key: value }` maps so the rest of the flow can use 
`={{ $node["2.0.1 Settings to map"].json.parser_url }}` style expressions.

Inserts a fresh `wf_runs` row with `status=running`. The same `run_id` is updated at the end.

### Per-channel loop

For every active row of `wf_channels` we resolve / create the channel-specific Google Sheets 
file in the configured Drive folder, ask the Render parser for the latest posts, drop 
duplicates by `post_uid`, and feed remaining posts into the per-post sub-loop sorted from 
oldest to newest (publication order).

### Per-post loop

Reserves the row in Sheets first (`status=processing`), then asks AI to rewrite. 
AI uses an OpenRouter chat model + Structured Output Parser. Sanitize step removes 
leftover `t.me` links, "Источник" lines, etc.

After AI we publish to Telegram, Facebook Page and Instagram in sequence. Each platform 
is wrapped in a single chain that captures its result/error into `tg_*`, `fb_*`, `ig_*` 
fields without breaking siblings.

### Finalize

After both loops end, `11 Aggregate run stats` collects counters from the `Per-post counters` 
side-channel, `11.1 Update wf_runs row` writes the final status and report text, 
`12 Send Telegram report` publishes the report into the closed Telegram group 
(`wf_settings.report_chat_id`).

const j = $input.item.json || {};
const orig = $('5 SplitInBatches per post').item.json || {};
const t = new Date().toISOString();
const sheetsBody = JSON.stringify({
  values: [[
    t, t,
    String(j.run_id || orig.run_id || ''),
    String(j.channel_key || orig.channel_key || ''),
    String(j.post_uid || orig.post_uid || ''),
    String(j.post_id || orig.post_id || ''),
    String(j.post_url || orig.post_url || ''),
    String(j.post_date || orig.post_date || ''),
    Number(j.views || orig.views || 0),
    String(j.source_text || orig.source_text || ''),
    String(j.source_text_hash || orig.source_text_hash || ''),
    String(j.media_type || orig.media_type || ''),
    String(j.photo_url || orig.photo_url || ''),
    String(j.video_url || orig.video_url || ''),
    String(j.rewritten_text || j.facebook_text || j.instagram_caption || ''),
    String(j.instagram_caption || ''),
    String(j.tg_status || ''),
    String(j.tg_result || ''),
    String(j.fb_status || ''),
    String(j.fb_result || ''),
    String(j.ig_status || ''),
    String(j.ig_result || ''),
    String(j.overall_status || ''),
    String(j.error_message || ''),
    JSON.stringify(orig.post || {}),
    String(j.vk_status || ''),
    String(j.vk_result || ''),
    String(j.result_json || '')
  ]]
});
return { json: { ...j, sheetsBody } };
